app_summary: Chat with language models on your computer
app_description: Chat with language models that run entirely on this computer, through ruscallama-engine. Nothing you write leaves the machine.
ai_note: Design, specifications and testing by the author; code written with the assistance of AI tools.
empty_desc: The model runs on this computer: nothing you write is sent over the internet.
models_folder_hint: Copy GGUF files here to find them in the list
no_model_sub: Choose a GGUF file or copy one into the models folder
reasoning_sub: The model thinks before answering: better on hard questions, slower
system_default: You are RuscaLLama, a helpful and accurate assistant running locally.
sampling_sub: Changing a value switches the style to Custom
p_top_p_sub: Keeps only the most probable words up to this share
p_top_k_sub: Number of candidate words at each step (0 = no limit)
p_min_p_sub: Discards words much less likely than the best one
p_presence_penalty_sub: Above zero, encourages new topics and words
p_seed_sub: −1 random; a fixed value repeats the same answers
engine_desc: Changes apply when the engine restarts.
gpu_sub: Much faster; turn off if the driver gives problems
threads_sub: This computer has {n} physical cores: use as many
context_sub: Tokens the model can keep in mind; more uses more memory
vision_sub: Lets the model read attached images
vision_none: Needs an mmproj file next to the model
speculative_sub: Uses the model's MTP draft to answer faster
speculative_none: Needs a model with MTP or a draft file next to it
banner_no_engine: ruscallama-engine is not installed: install it to use RuscaLLama.
banner_restart: Settings changed: restart the engine to apply them.
engine_not_ready: The engine is not ready. Check the engine log.
needs_vision: To send images, turn on Vision with a model that supports it.
no_code: This answer has no code blocks
save_code_title: Choose a Folder for the Code
log_empty: The engine has not written anything yet.
font_size_sub: Ctrl++ and Ctrl+− change it, Ctrl+0 returns to the system size
